newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end weaker, Nikkei at one-month low.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end weaker, Nikkei at one-month low.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key Nikkei 225 index ended at its lowest level since February 7 on Thursday as sentiment weakened on a series of corporate scandals, brokers said.

The feeble tone was hurt further in late afternoon by rumours that Daiwa Securities Co Ltd was being inspected by Japan's securities watchdog. But Daiwa told Reuters it was undergoing a routine inspection and not a special check.
The Nikkei average of 225 first-section shares shed 282.79 points or 1.56 percent to end at 17,900.48.
